draft.shortGloss: plate; metal platter; traditional meal set
draft.emotion: warm and hungry, anticipation of a home-cooked meal
notes: While 'thali' can refer to a simple metal plate, it is very commonly used to describe a complete meal served on such a platter, consisting of various small bowls containing different dishes.
Do not confuse this with 'plate' in the Western sense of a ceramic dinner plate; 'thali' almost always implies a stainless steel, circular platter.

senses.definition: A flat, round dish, usually made of metal, used to serve or eat food from.
